description: Orchid convention core. Guard: before Edit, Write or MultiEdit, deny fragment-safe rule violations from every installed pack's guard.json. Lint: after the write, run each covering pack's declared linter on the whole file. Baseline: at session start, record the repo state the gate measures changes against. Gate: at Stop (and SubagentStop for agent types matched by the gated_agents option), block until the current change set is scanned and sealed. All layers find packs by their pack.json file globs, so one registration serves every stack.
